newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama investment bank buys stock exchange firm.
newsitem.headline: Panama investment bank buys stock exchange firm.

text.p: Wall Street Securities, one of Panama's largest investment banks, acquired 100 percent of a leading stock exchange company and pension fund administrator, a company official said Friday.
It bought Inversiones Bursatiles de Panama SA and Administradora de Fondos Activa SA, said Roberto Jimenez, director of corporate finance.
Both companies are part of the Galindo Group, one of Panama's most important family enterprises. The company makes cardboard boxes and other products throughout Central America.

The move will give Wall Street Securities access to one of the highest volume seats on Panama's small, but burgeoning 11- share stock exchange, Jimenez said. "We also plan to develop and grow our pension fund business," he added.
Inversiones Bursatiles, which holds a seat on Panama's stock exchange, will be renamed Wall Street Compania Bursatil. In turn, the Galindo Group will buy a stake in Wall Street Securities.
